svg.title: Suminagashi: four weeks of contributions as floating ink
svg.desc: Each day from 01 November to 28 November 2026 falls into a bath of water as a drop of ink, wider for a busier day: 2017 contributions on 28 days.
svg.text: A drop for every day of the last four weeks; a busier day, a wider ring.
NOV 01 – NOV 28 · 2017 CONTRIBUTIONS ON 28 OF 28 DAYS · BUSIEST NOV 17 (158), IN VERMILION
